methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,738 home improvement stores in the U.S. with approximately 195 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2022 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and omnichannel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools. Further, online and omnichannel retailers continue to focus on delivery services, as customers are increasingly seeking faster, guaranteed delivery times, including same-day and next-day fulfillment, low-price or free shipping, and convenient pick-up options, including curbside pick-up, in-store pick-up, and touchless lockers, and we must make investments to keep up with our customers’ evolving shopping preferences.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'For purchases made on Lowes.com, customers may pick up their purchase in-store at the customer service desk, curbside, or from touchless lockers, or have their purchase delivered to their home or business.'. The stock trades at 19.9x FY24E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,738 home improvement stores in the U.S. with approximately 195 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.83x; +33% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.23; conservative 2yr -11%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.2%/yr (worst year FY13-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-1.3%/yr (FY24 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.9%/yr (FY13-FY23 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +44.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2024-03-08) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.83x (34.3% downside to Bear $159 / +41.4% upside to Bull $342) | Adj composite 1.41 vs market 2.64: gap -1.23 [OVERVALUED] | +33% above the EPP floor $182 (15x FY24E $12.15) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.9% total (-5.4%/yr) | At 19.9x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $320 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps -6.2% in Q4 FY23, forward sales -2.8% to -1.6% (FY24 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
